result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. The cli module compiles and its tests pass (`mvn -o -pl cli test`).

Changes:
- **`Commands.java`**: added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and its description (the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`). It is listed in the no-argument usage overview, just before `updateLandscape`. `updateLandscape` and its description are unchanged.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method. `-help` prints the usage under the name the user typed, so `analyzeLandscape -help` shows its own name and description and `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.

I did not run `analyzeLandscape` end to end. Running the built jar needed an approval I couldn't get, so the help output and the `<folder>/_sokrates_landscape` output are verified by reading the code only.

**README:** it has no command descriptions (it covers only build, Docker and `init`), so I left it unchanged. If you want a command reference added there, say so and I'll write one.

Nothing is committed.
